items.summary: Apple's annual four-day Black Friday through Cyber Monday shopping event is now live in Australia , New Zealand , and Thailand , and it will continue to roll out across Europe, the U.S., and Canada as the calendar turns to Friday, November 27 around the world. In the U.S., Apple's terms and conditio…
items.body: Apple's annual four-day Black Friday through Cyber Monday shopping event is now live in Australia , New Zealand , and Thailand , and it will continue to roll out across Europe, the U.S., and Canada as the calendar turns to Friday, November 27 around the world. In the U.S., Apple's terms and conditions say the promotion begins on November 27 at 12 a.m. Pacific Time and ends on November 30 at 11:59 p.m. Pacific Time. During the shopping event, customers can get an Apple gift card with the purchase of an eligible product at an Apple Store, in the Apple Store app, and on Apple.com. However, the gift card can only be used towards future purchases, and higher immediate discounts on Apple products are frequently available at Amazon and other resellers. In the U.S., Apple is offering gift cards worth up to $300 with the purchase of an eligible iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, HomePod, AirPods, Beats headphones, Beats Pill speaker, Apple Pencil Pro, and select Magic Keyboards for iPads. For the first time ever, Apple is also offering a $25 gift card with select third-party accessories from brands including Anker, Belkin, Mophie, Nimble, Rains, and Twelve South. The selection includes chargers and MacBook covers. As usual, many of Apple's newer products are excluded from the offer, including the iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max, iPhone Duo, MacBook Neo, latest models of the iPad mini, Apple TV 4K, iMac, and Mac Studio, and more. Refurbished products are also ineligible, and the offer cannot be combined with educational pricing. We have listed the gift card values in the U.S. below. $25 Apple Gift Card: AirPods 5 AirPods 5 with Wireless Charging Case HomePod mini 2 Beats Pill Magic Keyboard for 11-inch iPad Air Magic Keyboard for 13-inch iPad Air Magic Keyboard for 11-inch iPad Pro Magic Keyboard for 13-inch iPad Pro Apple Pencil Pro Third-party accessories: Anker 3-in-1 Cube with Qi2 Belkin UltraCharge Pro 2-in-1 Convertible Magnetic Charger Belkin UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 Magne

items.title: 美国纽约州签署法案，限制汽车厂商对预装功能收取订阅费
items.summary: 2026年11月24日，美国纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔签署一项编号为S.9348A/A.10411A的法案。该法案自2027年2月27日起生效，规定汽车制造商、经销商以及第三方服务提供商不得针对使用预装组件或硬件、且不会产生持续性成本的汽车功能，额外提供订阅服务或在车辆售出后收取费用。 法案将于2027年2月27日生效，违者每个销售点每次违规最高罚款250美元。 在法案签署前，汽车经销商莫霍克雪佛兰（MohawkChevrolet）总裁AndyGuelcher表示，订阅制有助于维持汽车基础售价，消费者可以按照自身需求启用部分功能。 https://www.news18a.com/~ https:/…
items.body:
美国纽约州签署法案，限制汽车厂商对预装功能收取订阅费

2026年11月24日，美国纽约州州长凯西·霍楚尔签署一项编号为S.9348A/A.10411A的法案。该法案自2027年2月27日起生效，规定汽车制造商、经销商以及第三方服务提供商不得针对使用预装组件或硬件、且不会产生持续性成本的汽车功能，额外提供订阅服务或在车辆售出后收取费用。
法案将于2027年2月27日生效，违者每个销售点每次违规最高罚款250美元。

在法案签署前，汽车经销商莫霍克雪佛兰（MohawkChevrolet）总裁AndyGuelcher表示，订阅制有助于维持汽车基础售价，消费者可以按照自身需求启用部分功能。

https://www.news18a.com/~
https://www.governor.ny.gov/~

说的就是方向盘/座椅加热、通风、CarPlay之类的不联网功能
